scripts.ncu:minor: ncu -t minor -u && pnpm -r exec ncu -t minor -u
scripts.ncu:patch: ncu -t patch -u && pnpm -r exec ncu -t patch -u
scripts.prepare: rimraf .husky && husky && echo "npx commitlint --edit $1" >> .husky/commit-msg && echo "pnpm -r lint" >> .husky/pre-commit && echo "pnpm -r format" >> .husky/pre-commit && echo "pnpm ts-prune" >> .husky/pre-commit
scripts.update: pnpm ncu:patch && pnpm ncu:minor && pnpm ncu:major
